data.final_access: Only a committed separate confirmation registration may render final trajectories. Structural counts may be audited before fitting.

training.selection: Lowest validation loss among measurements passing every acquisition slice; tiny uses training loss. If none qualifies, retain failure and the lowest-loss diagnostic snapshot.
training.supervision: All prefix outcome bits for both arms, free running from the initial state. No intermediate observations are fed at inference or by teacher forcing.
training.stage_initialization: Each stage and condition starts from fresh parameters, with paired arm seeds and identical minibatch schedules.

search_rule: Run all three seeds at lr003 per arm/stage. Use lr010 only if lr003 lacks all-seed acquisition. Advance an arm only after all three seeds pass its preceding stage. Select the first all-seed-passing condition. Development transfer requires all-seed mixed acquisition. Confirmation requires direct baseline acquisition; a candidate failure remains a scoped result.
preflight: 24 synthetic-label updates per arm, length 3; 8 warmup and 16 timed. Project 2048 updates below 70 seconds before admitting fitting. Durations are fixed equally across learning rates; stop rather than alter them after observing acquisition.
confirmation: Separate registration after development; five fresh paired seeds, frozen settings, final-family effects and failed-seed treatment. No final tuning.
teacher_assistance: Own synthetic simulator supplies every prefix label; Codex assisted development code.
artifact_rights: Own-initialized parameters and synthetic data; private same-disk backup authorized by owner, no publication or retirement.
claim_boundary: Supplied observed-state coordinates, action bank and prefix supervision; fixed learned transitions versus dense recurrent sequence predictor. Limited composition probe, no original foundation, selective activation, continual learning or language claim.
